responsibility: Implements core behavior shared across declaration nodes and a large portion of the runtime TypeInfo declaration family. This file handles declaration access/modifiability checks, disabled-use diagnostics, nested-frame accessibility for aggregate fields, type-based member lookup fallback, and constructs the front end symbols representing generated TypeInfo objects for many D type categories, as well as special declarations like the implicit `this` parameter.
same_name_distinction: Contains the shared implementation for declaration behavior and generated declaration forms—such as modification/disabled checks, type-based member lookup, frame-access checks, and TypeInfo/implicit `this` declaration construction—whereas `declaration.h` primarily defines the declaration hierarchy, flags, and class interfaces.
